component_rules: Excluded and counted: other conditional components (sub_component 'conditional'/'conditional_credit' or notes starting 'Conditional'), alternatives, optional components, components expired (end_date before the as-of date) or not yet effective, value-less market energy (model state market_energy_pending), value-less market-indexed non-energy charges (named in the method; the state does not change) and percentage adjustments (no computable base).

Included as reference-customer charges: conditional components that a reviewed usage_levels.json 'reference_customer' entry lists for the province, fuel and sector (Ontario: Class B CBR, Standard Supply Service administration, non-wholesale-market-participant riders, and non-RPP Class B Global Adjustment riders at 50 kW and over), itemized with reason 'reference_customer:<id>'.

Included as reference-customer fixed-charge variants: a fixed charge published as variants of one charge by phase or amperage (unconditional variants or alternatives) is priced with the one variant that the level's usage_levels.json 'fixed_charge_variants' rule selects (user decision 2026-10-30: homes single-phase 200 A service; commercial under 50 kW single phase at the 10 kW level and three phase at the 25 kW level), itemized with reason 'fixed_charge_variant:<id>'.

Included: unconditional components in effect at the as-of date (fixed, energy, distribution, demand, transmission, regulatory, riders, carbon, other) in $/month, $/30 days, $/day, $/year, $/two months (/ 2), $/kWh, $/MWh, $/kW, $/kVA (per month or per day).

Not computable (record left out at that level, reason listed): a charge published only as conditional alternatives, fixed charges published as variants of one charge (e.g. by amperage or phase) when no usage_levels.json 'fixed_charge_variants' rule of the level selects exactly one variant, an unconditional component without value or in an unsupported unit (e.g. per billing period), TOU periods without an official share, ambiguous tier thresholds, seasons that do not cover the year, demand charges at a level without kW.

Thresholds as published: demand charges with a demand threshold bill only the kW above it; demand and energy blocks use their published bounds (kVA bounds at the power factor; per-kW and per-kVA energy blocks scale with the level's demand; per-day blocks x days per month; a block published in bare 'kWh' only with the first matching reviewed entry of data/models/block_periods.json: month as published, two months / 2, day x days per month; a null period or no entry is not computable).

base.method: Modeled comparison indicator, not a tariff anyone is billed. Median of 3 Alberta service areas' commercial 500-4,999 kW demand-billed tariffs at each usage level, each counted once (zone policy 'median_of_zones': the median of each utility's standard rate-zone records covering the level; 4 with more than one zone record). Alberta service areas: each wires utility is paired with the Rate of Last Resort provider for its area (ENMAX Power + ENMAX Energy Corporation in Calgary; ATCO Electric + Direct Energy Regulated Services; EPCOR Distribution + EPCOR Energy Alberta in the EPCOR Distribution area; FortisAlberta + EPCOR Energy Alberta in the FortisAlberta area); each service area counts once and every component keeps its own source and dates. The cities of Lethbridge and Red Deer publish both their distribution tariff and their area's Rate of Last Resort, and the City of Medicine Hat's bundled rate covers its delivery charges and its own default energy price, so each city is one service area. Rate of Last Resort energy (price fixed to December 31, 2026) applies only below 250,000 kWh a year; at larger levels the wires charges are used alone and energy is pending (Alberta pool price, Phase 6C). Direct Energy Regulated Services' daily administration charge is not included (its current value is published without an effective date). EPCOR Distribution's 2026 rates are interim (medium confidence). Energy: market-priced energy is pending (Phase 6/7E); costs are delivery and regulatory charges only, never a guessed energy price. Excludes market-indexed charges with no stored value that are not the energy price (Transmission Operating Reserve Charge (AESO pool price x 8.09% (operating reserve))), pending Phase 6C; the model state does not change. Usage levels: l1 500,000 kWh at 1000 kW/month. Conversions: $/day x 30.4375; $/kW/day x 30.4375. With tax: GST 5% of the pre tax subtotal; lines never compound. Excluded components: alternative 5 (e.g. Distribution System Usage Charge (kVA), Local Facilities Charge (kVA), Option A Local Facilities Credit (kVA)); conditional 3 (e.g. Charge for Deficient Power Factor, Option I Interval Metering Service Charge, Option A Local Facilities Credit (kW)); market pending 3 (e.g. Energy at market prices through a retailer (Alberta pool price; pendin); market indexed non energy 1 (e.g. Transmission Operating Reserve Charge); percentage base not computable 1 (e.g. Base Transmission Adjustment Rider). Mapped but not contributing: ENMAX Power + ENMAX Energy Corporation (see exclusions). Not modeled: municipal franchise and local access fees; competitive retail energy contracts (only the Rate of Last Resort is priced). Coverage: 3 of 5 Alberta electricity service areas with live records; no mapped record: Alberta Electric System Operator. Included: unconditional components in effect at the as-of date (fixed, energy, distribution, demand, transmission, regulatory, riders, carbon, other) in $/month, $/30 days, $/day, $/year, $/two months (/ 2), $/kWh, $/MWh, $/kW, $/kVA (per month or per day).

Not computable (record left out at that level, reason listed): a charge published only as conditional alternatives, fixed charges published as variants of one charge (e.g. by amperage or phase) when no usage_levels.json 'fixed_charge_variants' rule of the level selects exactly one variant, an unconditional component without value or in an unsupported unit (e.g. per billing period), TOU periods without an official share, ambiguous tier thresholds, seasons that do not cover the year, demand charges at a level without kW.

Thresholds as published: demand charges with a demand threshold bill only the kW above it; demand and energy blocks use their published bounds (kVA bounds at the power factor; per-kW and per-kVA energy blocks scale with the level's demand; per-day blocks x days per month; a block published in bare 'kWh' only with the first matching reviewed entry of data/models/block_periods.json: month as published, two months / 2, day x days per month; a null period or no entry is not computable).

component_rules: Excluded and counted: other conditional components (sub_component 'conditional'/'conditional_credit' or notes starting 'Conditional'), alternatives, optional components, components expired (end_date before the as-of date) or not yet effective, value-less market energy (model state market_energy_pending), value-less market-indexed non-energy charges (named in the method; the state does not change) and percentage adjustments (no computable base).

Included as reference-customer charges: conditional components that a reviewed usage_levels.json 'reference_customer' entry lists for the province, fuel and sector (Ontario: Class B CBR, Standard Supply Service administration, non-wholesale-market-participant riders, and non-RPP Class B Global Adjustment riders at 50 kW and over), itemized with reason 'reference_customer:<id>'.

Included as reference-customer fixed-charge variants: a fixed charge published as variants of one charge by phase or amperage (unconditional variants or alternatives) is priced with the one variant that the level's usage_levels.json 'fixed_charge_variants' rule selects (user decision 2026-10-30: homes single-phase 200 A service; commercial under 50 kW single phase at the 10 kW level and three phase at the 25 kW level), itemized with reason 'fixed_charge_variant:<id>'.

Included: unconditional components in effect at the as-of date (fixed, energy, distribution, demand, transmission, regulatory, riders, carbon, other) in $/month, $/30 days, $/day, $/year, $/two months (/ 2), $/kWh, $/MWh, $/kW, $/kVA (per month or per day).

Not computable (record left out at that level, reason listed): a charge published only as conditional alternatives, fixed charges published as variants of one charge (e.g. by amperage or phase) when no usage_levels.json 'fixed_charge_variants' rule of the level selects exactly one variant, an unconditional component without value or in an unsupported unit (e.g. per billing period), TOU periods without an official share, ambiguous tier thresholds, seasons that do not cover the year, demand charges at a level without kW.

Thresholds as published: demand charges with a demand threshold bill only the kW above it; demand and energy blocks use their published bounds (kVA bounds at the power factor; per-kW and per-kVA energy blocks scale with the level's demand; per-day blocks x days per month; a block published in bare 'kWh' only with the first matching reviewed entry of data/models/block_periods.json: month as published, two months / 2, day x days per month; a null period or no entry is not computable).
